responsibility: Declares the D front end’s aggregate-type symbol hierarchy for structs, unions, classes, and interfaces. This file owns the core metadata and semantic state for aggregate declarations—field lists, nesting, constructors/destructors, invariants, vtables, base-class relations, ABI/linkage kind, Objective-C/C++ integration flags, layout status, and TypeInfo-related hooks—and provides the key APIs used by semantic analysis and back-end glue to compute sizes, resolve inheritance, manage special members, and describe runtime class/struct layout.
